units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 20b:3">R. Hash. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ העיבור</he> the Principle of Intercalation (title of a book).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:27">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>ס׳ הלבנה</he> the principle of the lunar calendar.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:5">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 13:9">Ez. XIII, 9</cite>) <he>זהו ס׳ העיבור</he> that means the council (of the Sanhedrin) for intercalation; <cite ref="Ketubot 112a:16">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:14">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>זה עיבור</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Eruvin 65a:19">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite> (ref. to the numerical value of <he>י̇י̇ן̇</he> and <he>ס̇ו̇ד̇</he>) <he>נכנס יין יצא ס׳</he> where the wine enters, counsel leaves; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:3">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Num. R. s. 10</cite>; s. 11.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Ib.</cite> <he>יצא יין נכנס ס׳</he> when the wine has left (where there is abstinence), deliberation enters.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 3:32">Prov. III, 32</cite>) … <he>הוא נוזר זוכה לס׳ החכמה</he> he is abstinent …, therefore he is granted the counsel of divine wisdom.
<cite ref="Proverbs 3:32">Ib.</cite> <he>אנשי סוֹדוֹ</he> the men of his (God’s) counsel, i.e. his friends.
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:8">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ס̇ו̇דנ̇א̇</he>) <he>ס̇ו̇ד̇ נ̇א̇ה וכ׳</he> (beer-brewing is) a profitable device and a charity (requiring a very small capital); a. e.

senses.gloss: secret. Ib. 49ᵇ אין מגלין להן ס׳ we must not entrust a secret to them.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 14a:2">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>הקב״ה מגלה להם ס׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord shall reveal a secret (solve mysteries) to them in the hereafter.
<cite ref="Yevamot 63b:15">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> (fr. Ben Sira) <he>גַּלֵּה ס׳ וכ׳</he> reveal a secret to one out of thousand; a. e.
